title: Provider connection status
description: Engine to Laravel: answer to GET or DELETE /internal/connections/{connectionId}?provider={provider}. Reads only the engine's stored sign-in and makes no provider call.

status.description: unreadable: a sign-in or key is stored but this engine cannot decrypt it; connecting again replaces it. unreachable: the local model server is configured but did not answer. reauth_required: the provider rejected the stored sign-in's renewal since this engine started; signing in again replaces it.

expiresAt.description: Unix time in milliseconds when the current access token expires. The engine renews it automatically.

models.description: Chat model IDs in the engine's catalog for this provider. Whether a plan may use one is decided by the provider.
